get.description: This API fetches workflow rules for a department with optional module and status filters.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Department under which rules are created

schema.description: Department under which rules are created

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the workflow rules must be listed

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of workflow rules to list. Minimum 1, maximum 50, default is 50

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module API name filter. Standard modules: tickets, tasks, products, accounts, contacts, timeEntry. Custom modules use a cm_ prefix.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Workflow status filter. Allowed values: ACTIVE, INACTIVE

post.description: This API creates a workflow rule in the specified department and module.

get.description: This API fetches a workflow rule by its identifier.

patch.description: This API updates a workflow rule. Department and module cannot be changed on update.

delete.description: This API deletes a workflow rule by its identifier.

get.summary: List criteria fields for workflow rules
get.description: This API lists the fields allowed in criteria for workflow rules. Available predefined values may contain EMPTY, NOTEMPTY, OPEN, CLOSED, and CURRENTTIME placeholders. Available field types are Text, Date, DateTime, Boolean, and Arithmetic.

parameters.description: Department under which rules are created

schema.description: Department under which rules are created
